run_client_rpc: run a distributed FAISS RPC client that creates an index, adds data, trains, and searches
add_train_data_client: add random training data to a distributed FAISS client index using torch tensors
call_async_train: trigger async training on a distributed FAISS client index
test_single_server_multiple_clients_thre: test a single FAISS server with 10 parallel client processes using multiprocessing
test_single_server_multiple_clients: test a single FAISS server with 10 in-process clients adding data and searching
